header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: — this I bear witness to,’ he will say. (On hearing this answer) it will be said to him, “Look at the place you would have had in Jahannam (had you not believed); Allah has given you a place in Jannah in its stead,’ (both places, in Jannah and in Jahannam, will be shown before him), (he will see both places together at the same time). If that servant was a munafiq or a kafir, (after he dies) he too will be asked about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; he will answer, “I do not know anything about this man; I only used to say what other people used to say about him.’ (To this answer of his) it will be said to him, “You neither came to know by yourself, nor did you follow those who knew. Then (to torment him) he will be struck with a hammer made of iron, and, unable to bear the pain, he will cry out so loudly that everything near him, except humans and jinn, will hear his screaming,’ — Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّي لَا يُقَالَ فِي اْلاَرْضِ: اللهُ اللهُ وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ عَلَي أَحَدٍ يَقُولُ: اللهُ، اللهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب ذهاب الايمان اخر الزمان، رقم: ٣٧٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “Qiyamah will not take place until there comes a time (utterly evil) when “Allah, Allah’ is no longer said in the world,” Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said. In another narration it is reported, “The Day of Qiyamah will not come as long as there is someone who says Allah, Allah.”
